tips_en: Start with the RARG paper (Paper 3) for its elegant insight that relevance should guide—not just filter—agentic search, with strong empirical results (84% on BrowseComp-Plus using only 24 tool calls). It pairs naturally with ReDesign (Paper 2): both are agentic systems that decompose complex tasks into structured tool calls with per-step verification (relevance reranking vs. tree-node verification), making them a complementary read on agentic tool composition. The HiFi-UMI paper stands apart as a robotics contribution and is best read separately if bimanual manipulation is your interest.
tips_zh: 推荐先读 RARG（论文3），其核心洞见——相关性应作为执行先验来引导而非仅仅过滤智能体搜索——十分精炼，且实证结果亮眼（在 BrowseComp-Plus 上仅用 24 次工具调用即达 84%）。它与 ReDesign（论文2）形成天然对照：两者都是将复杂任务拆解为结构化工具调用并逐步验证的智能体系统（前者是相关性重排，后者是树节点验证），适合连读以比较智能体工具组合的不同设计思路。HiFi-UMI 论文则偏向机器人领域，若关注双手操作可单独阅读。
